narrative_purpose: Stages the chapter's central contrast as a single image: on one side the brain as a colossal, dense block of wiring (the petabyte connectome); on the other the thin, luminous trickle of conscious experience flowing out of it — the million-fold gap that decides whether the soul-transfer is impossible or merely extravagant.
subject: A two-sided composition. On the left, a vast, dense, intricate lattice of neural wiring packed almost solid — overwhelming in its sheer volume, dimly lit, suggesting petabytes of static hardware. On the right, from that huge mass, a single fine bright thread of light escapes and flows away as a slender luminous stream — small, elegant, almost weightless against the bulk it came from.
scene: An abstract conceptual plate in dark space: a monstrous wiring-block on one side, a delicate escaping light-stream on the other, the visual disproportion between them the entire message.
camera: A head-on conceptual view holding both halves in one frame so the size contrast is immediate.
light: The connectome block dim and cool, near-uniform, vast; the conscious stream a bright, warm-cool thread that draws the eye precisely because it is so much smaller and cleaner.
palette: Void-indigo ground, teal-cyan dense wiring on the bulk side, a brighter cyan-white thread for the conscious stream, faint magenta depth.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, conceptual but observed.
detail_level: Crisp, dense, almost claustrophobic on the connectome bulk; clean and spare on the escaping stream.
composition: Heavy mass occupying one side and much of the frame, the thin stream crossing into open dark space on the other, exploiting the imbalance.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette. The whole point is scale disproportion — the connectome must dwarf the stream. Keep dark space around the thread for callout labels.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
